2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
13: 
14:   // Player configuration
15:   const player = {
16:     width: 50,

18:     x: width / 2 - 25,

21:     color: '#00f'
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Falling circles configuration
25:   const circles = [];
26:   const circleSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
27:   const circleRadius = 15;
28:   const circleSpeed = 2;
29: 
30:   // Game state
31:   let leftPressed = false;
32:   let rightPressed = false;
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   const gameDuration = 60 * 1000; // 60 seconds
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   // Input handling
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
40:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = true;
41:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = true;
42:   });
43:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
44:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = false;
45:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = false;
46:   });
47: 
48:   function spawnCircle() {
49:     const x = Math.random() * (width - circleRadius * 2) + circleRadius;
50:     circles.push({ x, y: -circleRadius, radius: circleRadius });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update(delta) {
54:     // Move player
55:     if (leftPressed) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
56:     if (rightPressed) player.x = Math.min(width - player.width, player.x + player.speed);
57: 
58:     // Spawn circles
59:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > circleSpawnInterval) {
60:       spawnCircle();
61:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
62:     }
63: 
64:     // Update circles
65:     for (let i = circles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
66:       const c = circles[i];
67:       c.y += circleSpeed;
68:       // Remove off‑screen circles
69:       if (c.y - c.radius > height) circles.splice(i, 1);
70:     }
71: 
72:     // Collision detection
73:     for (const c of circles) {
74:       const closestX = Math.max(player.x, Math.min(c.x, player.x + player.width));
75:       const closestY = Math.max(player.y, Math.min(c.y, player.y + player.height));
76:       const dx = c.x - closestX;
77:       const dy = c.y - closestY;
78:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < c.radius * c.radius) {
79:         gameOver = true;
80:         break;
81:       }
82:     }
83: 
84:     // Timer check
85:     if (performance.now() - startTime >= gameDuration) gameOver = true;
86:   }

95:     for (const c of circles) {

103:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

120:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
